editorial.blurb: Union Sushi + BBQ + Izakaya masterfully blends pristine sushi craftsmanship with smoky grilled dishes, all delivered with genuinely warm hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the sushi bar to watch Chef Toshi work and get real-time recommendations—and order the chu toro nigiri with caviar and wagyu nigiri specials, which reviewers called life-changing bites.
